items.name: echo
items.description: Update affected project documentation and owned instruction sections after implementation/review.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: forge
items.description: User-entered implementation persona; route tasks through the appropriate Dreamers skill.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: hone
items.description: Optional simplicity and architecture reviewer; explicit user selection only.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: nova
items.description: User-entered detailed-planning persona; save plans and the Grill transcript, then stop.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: probe
items.description: Optional test quality and coverage reviewer; explicit user selection only.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sage
items.description: Research selected topics and write evidence-backed reports in preliminary, deep, review, or synthesis mode.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sentinel
items.description: Optional correctness, security, and maintainability reviewer; explicit user selection only.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: vigil
items.description: Default code reviewer: correctness, security, maintainability, meaningful tests, and simplicity.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-add-logging
items.description: Audit logging, approve a proposal, apply fixes, optionally review with Vigil, and commit.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-clean-work
items.description: Maintain improvements and identify stale workspace or project instructions between milestones.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments
items.description: Audit comment rules, approve cleanup, apply it, optionally review with Vigil, and commit.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments-branch
items.description: Run comment cleanup on the current feature-branch diff.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-docs
items.description: Have Echo update affected documentation and project instruction sections; stage without committing.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-explain
items.description: Explain a topic, code, document, or decision with evidence and concrete examples.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-lite
items.description: Fix a bounded bug with meaningful regression coverage and verification; stop before review or shipping.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-find-refactors
items.description: Find refactor opportunities with section-scoped Vigil audits and write candidate plans; no implementation.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers
items.description: Deliver a task from approved proposal through implementation, Vigil review, docs, and PR. Detailed planning is opt-in.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-help
items.description: Read-only Dreamers command guide, workflow, review options, and gates.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-implement
items.description: Implement an approved proposal or detailed plan and return verified outcomes. No review or shipping.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-issue
items.description: Create a GitHub issue with outcome-based acceptance criteria; # prefix enables discussion first.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-new-project
items.description: Discover a new project, approve its stack and brief, bootstrap it, and write shell milestones.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan
items.description: Clarify requirements and write detailed plans on request. Save the Grill transcript and stop after approval.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan-verify
items.description: Check an existing proposal or detailed plan for drift against current code; report without edits.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr
items.description: Push the prepared branch, open a PR, and archive shipped plan artifacts.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr-resolve
items.description: Apply justified PR feedback, verify it, run Vigil, then push with approval and resolve accepted threads.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-research
items.description: Scope a research topic, run Sage research/review pairs, and synthesize a cited report.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-review
items.description: Review through Vigil by default; triad or selected reviewers only on explicit user request. Report findings without applying fixes.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-simplify
items.description: Audit code simplicity through Vigil without applying refactors.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-test
items.description: Audit meaningful test coverage through Vigil without writing tests.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-update
items.description: Maintain Copilot first, then transfer to Codex only after explicit approval.
items.author: CJ Storrs

collections.name: Dreamers System
collections.description: Compact Copilot delivery: approved proposal, implementation, Vigil review, mandatory close-out, and approved PR.
collections.author: CJ Storrs
